g.text: AISL-A GLOVE ENCLOSURE V3 (for carrier PCB v1)
Scale 1.5:1 on A4 landscape. Dimensions in mm. Dashed = hidden edges.
Walls: 2.4 short ends, 5.6 long sides. Floor 2.4, lid 2.4.
Cavity 69.2 x 47.7. PCB top at Z = 7.5, lid underside at Z = 27.0.
USB notch 16 wide; flex wire slot 50 x 6; BOOT / EN holes 9 dia.
Screws: 4 x M3 x 6 (PCB), 4 x M3 x 10 (lid), 2.6 mm pilots. Strap slots 26 x 6.
Fit prototype generated 2026-11-18. Not printed, not measured.
